ActiveTaskInfo.description: Display identity of a task whose subprocess is currently registered.

Attribution.description: Who is responsible for a finding.

Confidence.description: How much a finding can be trusted.

DiagnosisCost.description: Analysis usage only, separate from evaluation and scoring usage.

DiagnosisCoverage.description: Do not equate unavailable outcomes or absent facts with success or zero events.

DiagnosisReport.description: One analysis of a persisted (run, model, benchmark), with cache provenance.

DiagnosisRunRequest.description: Options for analyzing one existing dataset report.

DiagnosticSource.description: Redacted exact text supplied to the model, with an optional original message/step identity.

EventType.description: Canonical event kinds emitted by the AgentLoop or external-agent bridge.

Evidence.description: A short excerpt supporting a finding.

EvidenceReference.description: Offsets are zero-based Python Unicode character offsets, end-exclusive, in the supplied source.

ExecutionSubset.description: Completion counts for one evaluated subset.

ExecutionSummary.description: Run completeness kept separate from aggregation-specific metric counts.

Fact.description: An observation with an explicit denominator and computation definition.

FailurePattern.description: Observed issue types among failed or unscored samples; groups may overlap.

Finding.description: One problem detected in one sample.

JudgeSummary.description: First-class summary of a judge session, for reports and offline inspection.

LLMDiagnosis.description: A model hypothesis; valid citations do not establish semantic correctness.

MetricDisplayKind.description: How a metric value is rendered.

MetricKind.description: Whether a metric grades quality or only describes a run.

Narrative.description: Grounded summary and suggestions, without an unreferenced free-form summary field.

NarrativeItem.description: Every sentence has resolvable fact/sample references; it remains model-generated text.

NarrativeSampleReference.description: A summary citation resolved by the analyzer to one inspected sample and optional evidence step.

PredictionScore.description: Score fields rendered by the Web UI; metadata remains benchmark-defined.

ProgressResponse.description: Progress tracker payload with stable fields and tracker-specific metadata.

ReportGroup.description: One row per model in a `group_by=model` listing - display-only rollup, never a merged report.

SampleDiagnosesResponse.description: Filtered sample observations, paged after matching.

SampleDiagnosis.description: Official outcome and observed findings; a finding is not a proved root cause.

SampleKey.description: A persisted sample identity within one model and benchmark.

ScoreStatus.description:
Whether a score is usable, and why it is not.

A failed judge is not a zero: only ``SUCCESS`` and ``FALLBACK`` carry a score that may
enter aggregation. The remaining values mean the score is unavailable and the sample
must be excluded from the affected metric rather than counted as 0.

TraceUsage.description: Mirrors `evalscope.api.model.model_output.ModelUsage`'s shape for the response contract.
